description: This file defines the OrchardCoreBuilder class, which provides methods to configure services, request pipelines, and features for Orchard Core multi-tenant applications. It manages startup actions, service registration, and feature enabling.

classes.name: OrchardCoreBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring Orchard Core applications, including service registration, pipeline configuration, and feature management.

methods.name: RegisterStartup
methods.description: Registers a startup class of type T as a transient service implementing IStartup.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Configures services for each tenant, with overloads for different configuration actions.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the application's request pipeline, with overloads for different configuration actions, including async variants.

methods.name: EnableFeature
methods.description: Enables a feature by its ID, adding it as a singleton ShellFeature if not already enabled.
